title: CommandBatch
description: Guardian -> hubs, published on <root>/cmd/<bank_id>/batch, QoS 1. Signed envelope: see interfaces/crypto.md for the exact JCS signing input (all fields except signature/key_id).

epoch.description: Strictly increasing per hub; rejects replay/rollback (K6).

issued_at.description: valid_from: the envelope is not valid before this instant.

expires_at.description: Absolute deadline (lease-bounded); void if delivered later even with a valid signature.

precondition.description: Optional optimistic-concurrency precondition on ledger/commitment state this batch assumes (e.g. ledger_version). Absent means unconditional.

lease.description: Optional inline lease info accompanying this batch; canonical lease state is also published separately on <root>/lease/<hub_id>.

key_id.description: Identifies which Ed25519 public key verifies `signature`.
